PresignUploadResponse.description:

headers it must send. `Content-Length` and `content-type` are signed into
the URL, so B2 rejects a body of any other size or type.

info.description: Local API for DataComp Image-Text Filtering: a DataComp-style dataset curation pipeline that streams WebDataset image-text shards from Backblaze B2, scores image-text alignment with CLIP (open_clip), and writes filtered shards plus quality metrics back to B2. This contract documents the template's local API, not a hosted public endpoint.
info.title: DataComp Image-Text Filtering API

get.description:
Rich metadata (checksums, image/PDF fields) recomputed on demand.

Unlike /metadata (a cheap head_object), this downloads the object to
re-run extraction, so it is billed at the tighter 'write' rate-limit tier
(see runtime/ratelimit.py) to bound egress/cost amplification.

post.description:
Kick off a filter run. Marks it `running`, schedules the real CLIP filter
as a background task, and returns immediately. Execution NEVER 500s the POST:
a missing ML stack or empty pool persists the run as `failed`.

Validate a declared upload and hand back a presigned PUT.

The browser uploads the bytes straight to B2 with the returned URL, so they
never traverse this Function — that is what lifts Vercel's ~4.5 MB payload
ceiling. Size and content-type are signed into the URL (see the service).
Confirm an object just uploaded directly to B2 is valid and visible.
